text.p: Following are the main election campaign-related events scheduled for Thursday.
- Parliament's Standards and Privileges Committee publishes interim report on its investigation into allegations of sleaze against several MPs, most of them Conservatives, 1200 GMT.

- Labour leader Tony Blair, education and employment spokesman David Blunkett and Pearson Chairman designate Dennis Stevenson holds news conference at 1000 GMT on information technology following publication of Labour-commissioned report into information techology in schools.
- Labour leader Tony Blair visits London school at 1145 GMT.
- Final prime minister's question time of parliament 1530 GMT.
- House of Commons debate on jobs and inward investment.
- Parliament's Defence Committee publishes a report on Gulf War illnesses at 1400 GMT
